title: LLM Harms: A Taxonomy and Discussion
findings: The paper is a broad review of LLM harms and does not present original findings on religion. It cites external research [71] that quantifies religious bias in LLMs, positioning this as a type of representational harm that persists in modern models. The paper's main focus is on a comprehensive taxonomy of harms rather than a deep dive into any specific type of bias.
